note: 「환승 이별」 시리즈 ai-reel — 두 가상 인물(Codex 그림 생성으로 만든 AI 인물, samples/drama/hero.jpg·heroine.jpg)이 번갈아 나오는 드라마. 실제 인물 사진은 쓰지 않는다(사장님이 보낸 레퍼런스는 분위기만 글로 옮김). 구조는 잘 된 AI 드라마 시리즈(@cinefable26 「Love's Lie」 류)를 따름: 첫 프레임부터 사건 + 훅 자막 → 상대 쪽 장면(이유를 숨김) → 해결 도구(센딧 실제 화면) → 반응 → 「2화」 예고·댓글 질문. 사람 장면은 Gemini Omni Flash(「AI로 만든 장면」 표시), 앱 화면과 답장은 운영 코치 서버의 실제 결과. 이야기는 지어낸 것이라 캡션에 밝힌다. 사장님 요청 2026-11-19.

person.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 smartphone video with the realism of a casual Instagram vlog: filmed on a phone propped up on the nightstand facing him, a tiny handheld wobble, realistic skin texture, true-to-life colors.
The young man has the same face and hair as the man in the reference image (about 24, messy black layered hair with soft curtain bangs); keep his identity consistent for the whole clip. His outfit and the location are as described below, not as in the reference photo.
Late at night in a dark small bedroom lit only by a dim warm bedside lamp and the glow of his phone. He wears a plain black T-shirt and a thin silver chain. He holds his own smartphone in portrait orientation; the back of the phone faces the camera the whole time and its screen is never visible.
0-4s: from the very first frame he is lying in bed holding the glowing phone above his face; he reads and freezes, eyes widening, then slowly sits up against the headboard, stunned, and runs a hand through his hair.
4-8s: he exhales, jaw tight, types a short reply with both thumbs, hesitates for a beat, then taps send firmly and drops the phone face-down on the blanket, staring at the ceiling.
8-12s: the phone buzzes again; he grabs it, reads, and a slow, slightly bitter smirk appears; he shakes his head once, then looks straight into the camera with a calm, unreadable expression.
Audio: quiet room tone at night, a phone buzzing at the start and at 8 seconds, blanket rustle. No music. He does not speak: no dialogue, no voice-over.
No on-screen text, captions, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

4-8s: she opens her eyes, looks down at the phone again, waiting, then glances away toward the dark window with a sad, complicated look.
Audio: quiet room tone at night, a soft message-sent sound around 3 seconds. No music. She does not speak: no dialogue, no voice-over.

items.caption:
[환승 이별 1화] 날 차고 바로 다른 사람 만나던 전여친이, 3개월 만에 새벽 2시에 "자…?" 보냄.

센딧에 그대로 넣었더니 답장 3개를 성공 확률이랑 같이 골라 줬어. 앱 화면과 답장은 실제 센딧 AI 결과 그대로야.

※ 지어낸 이야기야. 사람 나오는 장면은 AI로 만든 연출이고, 마지막 카톡은 센딧이 예상한 답장이야.

2화에서 그녀가 돌아온 진짜 이유 공개. 너라면 받아 줄 거야, 읽씹할 거야? 댓글로 👇
